title: john malkovich mathilde arcel win top actors awards venice 2026 09 12
text:
VENICE, Sept 12 (Reuters) - U.S. actor John ​Malkovich won the ‌best actor award at ​the Venice ​Film Festival on Saturday ⁠for his ​performance as an ​ageing, maverick CIA agent in "Wild Horse ​Nine".
Denmark's Mathilde ​Arcel was named best ‌actress ⁠for "Woman Unknown", where she plays a housemaid ​whose ​relationship ⁠with a German ​soldier in ​World ⁠War Two comes back to ⁠haunt ​her.
